dct_description_sm:
Layer of dots showing where custom packaging services in Manitoba are located.

This dot layer shows where custom packaging services in Manitoba are located. A contract packager (subcontractor) is a company that manufactures and packages food products sold by other businesses. This list is not exhaustive and does not constitute a recommendation for services. For more information, visit the Manitoba Agriculture website. This point layer is used in the Manitoba Custom Packaging Services Map and the Manitoba Custom Packaging Services app.Fields included [Alias (Field Name): Field Description] Business Name
